info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-Delete Carrental Reservations Cancel-v2-spec
info.description: The Cancel Car Rental Reservations API enables users to efficiently cancel existing car rental reservations. This functionality is crucial for customers who may need to modify their travel plans or avoid potential no-show charges. By providing access to reservation management, businesses can enhance customer satisfaction and streamline their operations. Typical consumers of this endpoint include travel agencies and rental service providers looking to manage bookings effectively. The API ensures that all cancellation requests are processed accurately, maintaining the integrity of available vehicle inventory.

delete.description: This endpoint allows users to cancel a specific reservation. Once the reservation is canceled, it will no longer be valid, and any associated resources will be released.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to cancel an existing reservation. Ensure that you provide the correct reservation details to successfully process the cancellation.

200.description: The reservation has been successfully canceled.

DeleteCarrentalReservationsCancelRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for cancelling a reservation operation.

DeleteCarrentalReservationsCancelRespons.title: Cancellation Response

status.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for the cancelled reservation.

resultId.description: The ID of the result associated with the cancellation.

state.description: The current state of the reservation after cancellation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the cancellation, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the cancellation.

audit.description: Information related to the audit of the cancellation process.

DeleteCarrentalReservationsCancelRespons.description: Schema representing the response returned after successfully cancelling a reservation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The user who created the cancellation record.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the cancellation record was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was performed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Schema representing audit information related to the cancellation process.

x-processing-time.description: The time taken to process the cancellation request, measured in milliseconds.
